definition: Work on the garden that members describe as done together.
inclusion_criteria: Joint tasks, work rosters, collective workdays.

definition: Describing the garden as giving to people in need.
inclusion_criteria: Talk of donating, helping the needy, or good causes.

definition: Who holds the plot and on what terms.
exclusion_criteria: Where plants are placed within the plot.

inclusion_criteria: Cost of food, distance to shops, what people eat.

definition: Members tiring of or leaving the work.
inclusion_criteria: Fatigue, dropping out, too few hands.

definition: Dealings with the city or its staff.
